products.name: Respeecher
products.note: Voice cloning for media; entertainment focus; likeness rights; Ukrainian vendor

profile_text.body:
Respeecher is a Kyiv, Ukraine-based company whose team describes itself as dedicated sound professionals delivering high-quality AI-generated voice from source material. The company positions its technology for professional production workflows in film, games, broadcast, and enterprise media, emphasizing consistency, timing, tone, and emotional intent over generic output. Its site describes the core offering as a sophisticated AI system that converts textual or contextual inputs into human-like voice using neural network models and linguistic processing, and notes that the technology is tuned by sound engineers to avoid the flat, robotic quality the company associates with basic voice synthesis tools.

Respeecher's main products are a custom voice cloning service and a Text-to-Speech API, both available through a Marketplace. The voice cloning capability is described as replicating the vocal characteristics, emotional nuances, and speech patterns of specific individuals, including deceased subjects, and the site highlights rights management and ethical consent frameworks as part of its approach. The TTS API supports major global languages including English with multiple regional accents, and the system is described as language-agnostic for voice conversion when a voice actor records in a given language. Free testing is available before purchase.

The site's held facts classify Respeecher under the Voice and Audio category with a specific note on entertainment focus and likeness rights management. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server entries are recorded for the company at this time.
